Thesis, supervision and current position of our doctoral graduates. This page complements the [official website of the PhD programme](https://www.dems.unimib.it/en/programmes/post-lauream/phd-economics-statistics-and-data-science), which remains the reference for admission, regulations and courses. Current students are listed [here](students.qmd).

## Statistics curriculum, since cycle XXXIV

## Earlier doctoral programmes

Before 2018 doctoral training in statistics at Milano-Bicocca ran through other programmes: Methodological and Applied Statistics, Statistics, Statistics and Applications, and Statistics and Mathematical Finance (statistics curriculum only). The list covers the theses deposited in the [BOA institutional repository](https://boa.unimib.it) from 2010 onwards and, for 2001–2009, those held by the Italian national libraries ([OPAC SBN](https://opac.sbn.it)), which may be incomplete. Supervision is taken from the title page of each thesis (for 2001–2009, as recorded in the library catalogue); where the title page names only a tutor, the tutor is listed as supervisor. Current positions in Italian universities come from the [MUR register of academic staff](https://cercauniversita.mur.gov.it); the others are still to be completed.
